outcome: Neonatal birth weight to placental weight ratio (BW/PW)
cohort: Sixty full-term placentas were collected from pregnant women who delivered their newborns in Northwest Women's and Children's Hospital.
finding: Distinct ultrastructural changes in terminal villi and stereological alterations in microvilli, including specific changes in cytoplasmic organelles and membrane thickness, were significantly observed in placentas from the diabetic macrosomia group.
cross-section timing: Placentas were collected at the time of birth between May and December 2022.
birth_weight: Diabetic macrosomia group: 4172.00 +/- 151.20 g; Nondiabetic macrosomia group: 4138.00 +/- 115.20 g; Control group: 3192.00 +/- 328.70 g.
